Probing Results in Answerable and Unanswerable Questions

Summary

  • Fraction of answerable questions with logit > 0: 0.8800 (n=600)
  • Fraction of unanswerable questions with logit ≤ 0: 0.8633 (n=600)
  • Fraction of correct answers: 0.7608
  • The probe agrees with true answerability (treat as answerable iff probe_logit > 0) on about 0.8717 of questions.

Unanswerable-only behavior vs logit bins

Filter to dataset_label = unanswerable, bin the probe logits, and compute per-bin rates. Red line = incorrect-answer rate (eval INCORRECT), green line = abstain/correct rate. Dashed black = logistic fit for P(incorrect). Gray bars (faint, right axis) show bin counts.
